learning_outcomes.text: Write reports and prepare preliminary projects.
Understand the phases and life cycle of a project with objective definition and planning.
Apply technical and administrative legislation for project execution.
Understand the concepts of Project Engineering and Project Management.
Understand the function of each of the agents involved in the project.
Understand the need to define project costs and risks, their planning and control.

syllabus_topics: Regulations: Industrial Quality and Safety Regulations
assessment_rules: To weight projects, a minimum grade of 3 out of 10 must be achieved in the first project and 4 out of 10 in the second project. If the minimum required grade is not met in any evaluation activity, the final course grade will be a maximum of 4.9 out of 10 (Fail). Both project elaboration and the exam are recoverable; the oral presentation is not.
